text:
Sofia (People Ops): Quick draft: a tiny 'evidence & calibration matrix' + a 3-line self-review micro-template with behavioral anchors. Want to keep reviews lightweight but make evidence comparable across teams.

Sofia (People Ops): Idea: For each self-review claim, ask the author to add one evidence tag: `A: quantitative`, `B: mixed`, or `C: qualitative` + one line of proof. That helps managers calibrate faster.

Marco P (Engineering): Love it. Can we add a 1-sentence scoring rubric managers can use? e.g., "A=direct metric change tied to work; B=partial metric or customer story; C=anecdotal or growth-oriented"

Sofia (People Ops): Yup. Draft rubric below + micro-template and a 30s manager read-aloud script for calibration meetings.

Sofia (People Ops): Evidence & Calibration Matrix (copy-paste friendly):
```
Evidence tag legend:
- A: quantitative (metric delta OR eval id). Example: "P95 down 18% (dash-id 42)"
- B: mixed (one metric + one qualitative note). Example: "Canary reduced retries by 8% + customer case #113"
- C: qualitative (customer story, peer note). Example: "Reduced support tickets; see ticket 987"

Manager quick-score guide (for calibration):
- 4 = Exceeded widely (consistent A evidence + cross-team impact)
- 3 = Met expectations (A or B evidence; measurable outcome)
- 2 = Progressing (B or C; visible effort; follow-up plan)
- 1 = Needs attention (no evidence; blockers remain)
```

Tasha K (Eng Manager): This is great. One ask: add a short 'confidence' line where the reviewer states how confident they are in the measurement (High/Med/Low) and why. Helps when metrics are noisy.

Sofia (People Ops): Added. Also a self-review micro-template with behavioral anchors (single-line anchors to avoid iceberg essays).

Sofia (People Ops): Self-review micro-template (3 lines + evidence tag):
```
1) Impact: one-line summary (what changed & scope)
2) Behavior: one-line anchor (e.g., "led cross-team design reviews", "mentored 2 engineers")
3) Outcome & evidence tag: one-line measurable or qualitative result + tag (A/B/C)
Example: "Reduced P95 for chat-api by 16% (region-us-west) | Behavior: ran rollout + canary | Outcome: P95 -16% (dash-204) [A]"
```

Evan R (SRE): Suggestion: include a tiny ops-checklist that managers can paste into calibration threads: `Does evidence include dashboard link? Is rollout doc linked? Any post-rollout incidents?` Keeps technical artifacts present.

Sofia (People Ops): Perfect 1 adding ops-checklist. Also adding a 1-line manager calibration script to keep meetings efficient.

Sofia (People Ops): Manager calibration script (30s):
"We have each candidate's self-review micro-line and evidence tag. For each, state the score (1-4), the confidence (H/M/L), and one calibration note in 1 sentence."

Marco P (Engineering): Will pilot with my ICs. One more: please include a short note on peer quotes — encouraged but optional, and how to record them (one sentence pasted in).

Sofia (People Ops): Adding: `Peer quote encouraged: 1 sentence, paste in review as 'Peer: <quote> - <name>'`

hr-bot: Resource updated: https://handbook.redwood.company/people-ops/evidence-matrix (internal)

Tasha K (Eng Manager): LGTM. I'll run calibration this week using the script and report back on time-to-consensus.

Sofia (People Ops): Plan: finalize doc with these edits and add to the review form header so people see the tags while writing. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
